Include part seems fixed.
However, LOGGING seems causing an error
```
../redfish-core/include/utils/query_param.hpp:681:61:   required from here
  681 |         BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG("Traversing response at {}", newPtr);
  ```

This is interesting with `redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp`

https://jenkins.openbmc.org/job/ci-repository/99083/console

CI suggests
```
--- a/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp
+++ b/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@
 #include "utils/json_utils.hpp"
 #include "utils/time_utils.hpp"
 
+#include <stdlib.h>       <=====================
 #include <systemd/sd-bus.h>
 ```
 
 However, I add <stdlib.h>, the next CI suggests to remove it.
 
 https://jenkins.openbmc.org/job/ci-repository/99082/console
 
 ```
 diff --git a/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp b/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp
index 9cdbb774..36e238d4 100644
--- a/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp
+++ b/redfish-core/lib/certificate_service.hpp
@@ -21,7 +21,6 @@
 #include "utils/json_utils.hpp"
 #include "utils/time_utils.hpp"
 
-#include <stdlib.h>      <=====================
 #include <systemd/sd-bus.h>
 
```

This seems alternating.
Yep.  There's already a bunch of places I've handled this.

Myung, sorry, but I'm about to overwrite your changes.  They're a regression for the moment with the *_formatters stuff.

If you want to keep going on your own, please just delete the changeid from the commit and it will generate a new review that you can continue, and we can compare at the end.

ACK, please go ahead to overwrite any of my changes.
If needed, I'll use a different ChangeId for my changes.

I forked this commit to 77557 and I think the most of compilation issues seem fixed by the changesets

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/77557/4..8

However, there are remaining issues related to the generated message files by `scripts/parse_registries.py`.  I attempted to fix those by

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/77557/8..10

But I think we may need to add some pragma statement on those generated message files (which are generated by `scripts/parse_registries.py`)   like

```

#pragma clang diagnostic push 
#pragma clang diagnostic ignored "-Wunused"
...
#pragma clang diagnostic pop
```
See https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/77578

Thanks a lot.
I'll rebase 77557 on 77578 and see how it goes
It looks good
